observations: All 120 closed H4 bars are present. Window high 2850.00 at bar 1789977600000, window low 2358.62 at bar 1789488000000, and the last close 2740.20 sits in the upper ~22% of that 491.38-point window range.

Bars 1788350400000-1789718400000 (96 bars) overlap repeatedly inside 2358.62-2609.02 with many small dojis (e.g., bar 1788595200000 high 2458.92 low 2451.81, range 7.11) and no sustained directional sequence.

Two bull spikes out of that range were given back: bar 1788436800000 closed 2506.79 after a 2404.35-2509.15 range and price later closed 2450.96 (bar 1788523200000); bar 1789128000000 closed 2555.52 with a 2680.00 high and price closed 2479.76 eleven bars later (bar 1789286400000).

Breakout bars: bar 1789732800000 (open 2507.15, close 2578.60) and bar 1789747200000 (open 2579.97, close 2636.28 near its 2643.52 high) close above the 2609.02 prior range high, then 15 bars (1789761600000-1789963200000) overlap in a 2568.16-2700.00 box with contracting ranges (smallest 20.37 at bar 1789848000000).

The 2850.00-2716.01 pullback gives back 133.99 of the 281.84-point 2568.16-2850.00 leg (~48%) without reclaiming the 2700.00 breakout level.

structures.description: Dominant 96-bar trading range: bars 1788350400000-1789718400000 repeatedly overlap between the 2358.62 low and the 2609.02 high, and every spike leg out of it is largely given back within a few bars.

Bull breakout of the range: bar 1789732800000 (open 2507.15, high 2585.50, close 2578.60) and bar 1789747200000 (open 2579.97, high 2643.52, close 2636.28) close above the 2609.02 range high - the only sustained acceptance above that level in the window.

Fifteen-bar bull flag after the breakout: bars 1789761600000-1789963200000 overlap in a 2568.16-2700.00 box with contracting ranges (smallest 20.37 at bar 1789848000000) and hold far above the 2609.02 breakout level.

Second bull spike: bar 1789977600000 (open 2658.81, high 2850.00, low 2658.06, close 2723.15) breaks the 2700.00 flag high but closes 126.85 off its high in the lower third of its 191.94 range, so the breakout bar was sold into immediately.

Six-bar pullback/consolidation under the 2850.00 high: bars 1789992000000-1790064000000 overlap between 2716.01 and 2804.59 with lower highs (2795.00, 2804.59, 2776.18, 2741.20, 2752.61) while holding above the 2700.00 breakout level.

Possible mtr-like topping shape: a climactic bull spike to 2850.00 (bar 1789977600000) with a 126.85 upper tail, then a lower high at 2804.59 (bar 1790020800000). It is only a named possibility, not a reversal, while 2700.00 holds and no bear bar closes below the 2716.01 pullback low.

evidence_for: Since the 2358.62 low (bar 1789488000000) the window prints a ~40-bar run of higher swing lows (2435.71, 2486.12, 2568.16, 2646.02, 2716.01) and higher swing highs (2438.47, 2481.66, 2585.50, 2643.52, 2700.00, 2850.00), the textbook definition of a bull leg.

The 2609.02 range high was broken by two large bull bars (closes 2578.60 and 2636.28) and the following 15-bar flag held above 2568.16 rather than falling back into the 96-bar range - acceptance rather than a one-bar poke.
The active pullback retraces only ~48% of the 2568.16-2850.00 leg and holds above the 2700.00 breakout level, so bears have not reclaimed the prior structure.

Advance bars close near their highs (bar 1789704000000 close 2578.60 vs high 2585.50; bar 1789747200000 close 2636.28 vs high 2643.52; bar 1789977600000 reaches 2850.00), and the sequence of spikes separated by flags is a trending channel, not a neutral two-sided range at the right edge.
The last bar is a bull bar closing at 2740.20 in the upper half of its range, and no bar in the pullback closed below 2716.01.
evidence_against: 96 of the 120 bars sit inside a 2358.62-2609.02 trading range with complete givebacks of prior spikes (bar 1788436800000 close 2506.79 later traded to 2450.96; bar 1789128000000 high 2680.00 later traded to 2479.76), so a whole-window trading-range read remains defensible.

The 2850.00 breakout bar closed 2723.15, 126.85 below its high and in the lower third of its range, and the next five bars made lower highs with no close above 2775.61 - the breakout above 2800 has no follow-through yet.
The last six bars overlap in a 2716.01-2804.59 box with two bear closes (2738.87, 2724.95), so short-term Always-In has flipped down inside the pullback and is not currently long with high relevance.
Both earlier bull spikes in this window fully failed, so an unresolved spike into the window high has direct precedent for reversing.
The advance from 2568.16 to 2850.00 is only ~24 bars at the very right edge of a 120-bar window whose body is a range; the trend label rests on recent bars, not on the window majority.
transition_conditions: Bull continuation: a close above 2804.59 (bar 1790020800000 high) that then accepts above 2850.00 confirms the flag breakout and keeps the bull-trend/channel read with rising Always-In relevance.

Reversal: consecutive closes below 2716.01 (bar 1790049600000 low) and then below 2700.00 put price back inside the 2568.16-2700.00 flag and shift the read toward trading-range or an mtr-like reversal of the 2358.62-2850.00 leg.
Continued overlap strictly inside 2716.01-2804.59 with no boundary break degrades the read to a two-sided pullback/range with low Always-In relevance.
A close below 2568.16 would break the last higher swing low and mark the 2358.62-2850.00 advance as a completed leg.
A new spike bar that closes above 2850.00 without a large upper tail would restore a clearer breakout-spike phase rather than a channel phase.
